related.title: Galileo 木星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付分段緩衝圖、容量門檻與遺失區段，不僅總資料量。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver piecewise buffer curves,capacity gates and missing segments,not just total volume.
related.difference: 在低資料率模型中估算影像回傳時間，區分壓縮比、資料品質與通訊效率。
related.differenceEn: Estimate image downlink time in a low-rate model while distinguishing compression,quality and link efficiency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算前段 3.6 Mbit，再算後段淨增 2.4 Mbit，與總量式核對。
先把 10 MB 轉 80 Mbit，再除 160 bit/s，換成日。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute 3.6 Mbit before relay and 2.4 Mbit net increase afterward,checking the total formula.
Convert 10 MB to 80 Mbit,divide by 160 bit/s and convert to days.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Mars Exploration Rovers 火星車
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付分段緩衝圖、容量門檻與遺失區段，不僅總資料量。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver piecewise buffer curves,capacity gates and missing segments,not just total volume.
related.difference: 建立含固定生存負載與可延期科學活動的單日能量排程。
related.differenceEn: Build a daily energy schedule separating survival loads from deferrable science.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算前段 3.6 Mbit，再算後段淨增 2.4 Mbit，與總量式核對。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成日獲能 700 Wh、固定能耗 380 Wh、保留 80 Wh、科學負載 60 W。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：t=(700−380−80)/60。 結果約 4 h。可用科學時間=(日獲能−固定能耗−保留量)/科學平均功率；不能以日平均掩蓋瞬間功率限制。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute 3.6 Mbit before relay and 2.4 Mbit net increase afterward,checking the total formula.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic daily harvest is 700 Wh, fixed demand 380 Wh, reserve 80 Wh and science demand 60 W. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: t=(700−380−80)/60. Result ≈ 4 h. Science time=(daily harvest−fixed energy−reserve)/science power; daily averages do not remove peak-power limits.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
